meta.title: Reverse auction (tick 1): lower by exactly 1 (one tick)

steps.note: Open the prepared live reverse auction on the buyer’s Responses view; this is the required starting state for the existing event.
Switch to Vendor A’s separate supplier-portal session while keeping the buyer session available.
Open the live reverse auction in Vendor A’s event list and enter the pricing bid sheet.
Revise Vendor A’s existing bid from 100 to 99 and submit it, lowering the price by exactly one tick.
Confirm the vendor portal shows the revised bid as submitted and accepted.
Return to the buyer’s Responses screen to verify the revision from the buyer side.
Assert the buyer sees Vendor A’s direct response after the revision.
Open the buyer’s Master QCS comparison for the revised bid.
Verify the buyer’s Master QCS shows the revised rate of 99.
